1141: ਰੋਗ ਬੰਧ; ਰਹਨੁ ਰਤੀ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Because of the bonds of the disease, he cannot win even a little release from wandering through births.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਰੋਗੁ ਕਤਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Without the true Guru's shelter, this disease is not removed in any way. ॥3॥
The person on whom the Supreme Lord has shown mercy,
He takes by the arm and pulls out of the disease.
When he found the company of the holy, his bonds were broken.
Says Nanak: the Guru has wiped away the disease. ॥4॥7॥20॥
When God comes to dwell in the heart, great joy arises within,
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜ ॥
when God comes to dwell in the heart, all sorrows are destroyed,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, every longing is fulfilled,
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਕਬਹਿ. ਨ ਝੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one never frets with worry. ॥1॥
The one in whose heart God the King is revealed,
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਦੀਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the perfect Guru has dyed with love and joy within. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
When God comes to dwell in the heart, one becomes, as it were, king over all,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, all one's tasks are fulfilled,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one stays absorbed in deep spiritual joy,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one is ever cheerful. ॥2॥
When God comes to dwell in the heart, one becomes for ever rich in the wealth of the Name,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one is for ever saved from wandering after Maya,
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one enjoys every spiritual delight,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one no longer depends on anyone. ॥3॥
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
When God is revealed in the heart, one finds the home of stillness of mind,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one is absorbed in the state where no thoughts of Maya arise,
when God comes to dwell in the heart, one ever sings His praises,
O Nanak, and then one's mind is at home with the Lord. ॥4॥8॥21॥
Our Father, God, lives for ever;
my brothers who share the spiritual life with me have also gained lasting spiritual life,
my friends who share love for remembering the Name have become of unshakeable life,
and my family of senses now abides at God's feet. ॥1॥
ਹਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
I found spiritual joy, and then all of them were at ease,
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when the perfect Guru united me with God my Father. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The dwellings of my soul have risen above every pull of Maya;
my spiritual realms are so high that the messenger of death can ask nothing there.
My rule over my own senses has become for ever unshakeable;
my store of the Name is so great it cannot run out and stays for ever. ॥2॥
The glory of God that is spread through all the ages
is my glory too; the greatness of God in every place is my greatness,
the praise of God sung in every home is my praise,
and the devotion to God in all the worlds is my devotion. ॥3॥
God my Father has become manifest within my heart;
Father and son have joined in love, as a father loves his son.
Says Nanak: when God the Father is kind to one of His sons,
Father and son are merged in one love. ॥4॥9॥22॥
O Guru, Being without enmity, O God the Giver,
we are the ones who go astray, and You are the One who forgives.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ. ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ ॥
O true Guru, the sinner who finds shelter nowhere else,
when he comes to Your refuge, becomes pure of life. ॥1॥
By pleasing the true Guru, a person finds spiritual joy;
ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by holding the Guru in his heart, he gains every fruit he wishes for. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Guru, O Supreme Lord, I bow to You.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
This mind and body are Your gift, and all that is seen is Your land.
When the veil of attachment to Maya is lifted, then You come into view.
O King of all beings, You are the Master of all. ॥2॥
If it pleases Him, dry wood turns green;
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਾਂ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰਿਆ ॥
if it pleases Him, a pool forms on the desert.
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
When a person is pleasing to Him, he obtains every fruit;
by falling at the true Guru's feet, his worry goes. ॥3॥
1142: When God shows mercy even to a worthless one who eats what is others' due,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
his mind and body are cooled, and the life-giving water of the Name settles in his mind.
Those servants on whom the Guru, the Supreme Lord, is merciful,
O Nanak, are filled with delight on beholding Him. ॥4॥10॥23॥
My true Guru depends on no one and has no aim of his own;
this is the true Guru's lasting way.
My true Guru is the giver to all beings;
my true Guru is one with the Creator, the Being who shapes all. ॥1॥
There is no god like the Guru.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਸੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one on whose brow good fortune awakens takes the Guru's shelter. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My true Guru protects all beings;
my true Guru kills one's attachment to Maya and gives spiritual life.
This high glory of my true Guru
has become manifest in every place. ॥2॥
My true Guru is the strength of one who has no other support;
my true Guru gives him support within the home of his heart.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ; ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
I am for ever a sacrifice to the true Guru,
who has shown the straight path of spiritual life. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
One who has taken the Guru's shelter, no fear can overpower,
ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
one who has taken the Guru's shelter, no sorrow can torment.
O Nanak, I have searched the Smritis and the Vedas:
there is no difference between the Guru and the Supreme Lord. ॥4॥11॥24॥
Taking the Name, the mind comes out of darkness and shines,
ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਪਾਪੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗਇਆ ॥
for taking the Name, every sin leaves the body.
Taking the Name, it is as if every holy festival has been kept;
taking the Name, the bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage is done. ॥1॥
The Lord's Name is our place of pilgrimage;
the Guru has taught us this as the essence of spiritual understanding. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Taking the Name, every sorrow is driven far off;
taking the Name, even a great fool gains fine spiritual understanding.
Taking the Name, the light of spiritual life shines within,
for taking the Name, the snares of attachment to Maya are ended. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Taking the Name, the messenger of death does not come near;
one stays in God's presence and enjoys spiritual joy;
taking the Name, one is honoured by God Himself.
The Name is our lasting capital. ॥3॥
The Guru has given me this most excellent teaching:
that the Lord's praise and the Name are the mind's support.
O Nanak, those cross over the waves of vice who make repeating the Name their act of atonement;
all other rites are only to satisfy people. ॥4॥12॥25॥
Bow down to Him a hundred thousand times,
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
and offer up this mind to Him.
By remembering Him in meditation, all troubles are wiped away,
joy arises, and no pain can take hold. ॥1॥
Such a precious jewel is the Name that makes the heart pure,
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that repeating it, every task is fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
By His gracious glance the camp of sorrows is torn down;
one who holds His life-giving Name in the mind grows cool within.
ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
The Lord whose feet countless devotees worship
In an instant He fills empty hearts to the brim with virtues;
in an instant He makes green those dried up in spiritual life.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
In an instant He gives support to one who finds shelter nowhere;
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
in an instant He grants honour to one whom no one honours. ॥3॥
1143: The One Lord is fully present in all beings,
but only that person repeats His Name whom the perfect true Guru inspires.
The Lord's praise becomes the support of his heart,
says Nanak, on whom God Himself is merciful. ॥4॥13॥26॥
I was ill-fated, yet the Lord Himself adorned me;
giving me beauty and love, He joined me to His Name and made my life lovely.
My sorrow is gone and all my troubles are gone;
the Guru has become my mother and my father. ॥1॥
O my friends, O my companions, joy has filled the home of my heart,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਭੇਟੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for my Husband, in His mercy, has met me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The burning of craving is quenched, and every hope fulfilled;
the darkness has gone, and the light of spiritual understanding has dawned.
It is as if unbroken music of every instrument plays within, and a wondrous, astonishing state has come.
The perfect Guru has done it; this is the perfect Guru's grace. ॥2॥
The one within whom God the Sustainer is revealed,
by the sight of that one we are ever filled with delight.
ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
All virtues arise in his heart, as if a great treasure were gathered there,
the one to whom the true Guru has given the Name. ॥3॥
The person who meets his own Master,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
repeating the Lord's Name at all times, is cooled in mind and body.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ॥
Says Nanak: those who become dear to God,
the dust of their feet only a rare one obtains. ॥4॥14॥27॥
One gone astray does not delay in thinking of sin,
and feels no shame at all in going to a prostitute.
For Maya he can labour the whole day long,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ; ਬਜਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥
but when the time comes to remember the Lord, it is as if lightning falls on his head. ॥1॥
The world, clinging to Maya, has gone astray;
ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ; ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Lord who leads astray has Himself misled it, so it stays absorbed in useless affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
His life passes in watching Maya's shows,
and, fond of worthless Maya, he keeps cheating in his dealings.
His mind runs after the bonds of dealings that blind him with attachment,
but the Creator does not come into his heart. ॥2॥
ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Doing this again and again, he suffers sorrow,
and his tasks for Maya are never finished.
His mind is sunk in lust, anger and greed;
ਤੜਫਿ ਮੂਆ; ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
like a fish without water, he writhes and brings spiritual death on himself. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਰਾਖੇ; ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
But the one whose protector the Lord Himself has become,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
In the company of the holy he sings the Lord's virtues,
O Nanak, the one who has found the perfect true Guru. ॥4॥15॥28॥
The one to whom God shows His mercy obtains remembrance of the Name,
and enshrines the Lord's Name in his mind;
he keeps the word of the eternal Lord's praise in his heart and mind,
and by it the sins of many births go away. ॥1॥
The Lord's Name is the support of the soul.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ; ਤਾਰਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace repeat it always, brothers; it carries one across the world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Those on whose brows the Lord has written the gaining of this treasure of the Name,
those people receive honour in His presence.
Sing God's virtues, and the peace and joy of stillness of mind come;
one whom no one supports finds a place in the Lord's presence. ॥2॥
In every age, this is the essence and the core:
remembering the Lord is the true way of thinking about life.
1144: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ; ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
But only the one whom God Himself attaches to His hem is attached,
and he, asleep for many births in attachment to Maya, awakens. ॥3॥
O God, Your devotees rest on You, and You Yourself protect Your devotees.
You Yourself sing Your own greatness among them.
All beings and creatures are in Your power;
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
O God of Nanak, You are ever with all. ॥4॥16॥29॥
The Name of the Lord who knows every heart dwells in my heart;
the Name sets all my tasks right;
the Lord's Name pervades every pore of me;
the perfect true Guru has given me this gift. ॥1॥
The precious jewel of the Name has come to dwell in my heart;
the Name of the unreachable, boundless Lord is a treasure no price can buy. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Name is now my unshakeable master;
ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
the greatness of the Name shines within all beings.
The Name is now my banker whose house lacks nothing;
the Name is my master who depends on no one. ॥2॥
The Name and love for the Name have become my spiritual food;
the Name has become my mind's constant need.
By the grace of the Guru, the saint, I never forget the Name;
taking the Name, it is as if all instruments play within unceasingly. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
By God's grace I have found the Name, which is the nine treasures to me;
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
by the Guru's grace my love for the Name has formed.
They alone are truly rich, they alone are foremost,
O Nanak, in whose hearts the treasure of the Name dwells. ॥4॥17॥30॥
ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ; ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
O God, You alone are my father, You alone my mother;
You give me life and breath, and You give me every comfort.
ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਹਉ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
You are my Master, and I am Your servant;
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
apart from You I have no other support. ॥1॥
O God, in Your mercy grant me this gift,
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that I may praise You day and night. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O God, we beings are Your instruments, and You are the One who plays them.
ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ; ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
O Giver, we are beggars at Your door, and You give us alms.
By Your grace we go on enjoying countless delights;
O God, You alone are present in every body. ॥2॥
O God, only by Your grace can Your Name be repeated;
be kind, that I may sing Your virtues in the company of the holy.
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ; ਹੋਇ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
O God, by Your mercy every pain of mine is destroyed;
by Your kindness the lotus of my heart blossoms. ॥3॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru,
ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
whose sight fulfils every wish and whose service makes life pure.
Be merciful, O my Master, O my God,
that Nanak may ever sing Your virtues. ॥4॥18॥31॥
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
The Lord whose court is higher than the courts of all kings,
to Him one should bow for ever and ever.
ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ. ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨ ॥
The Lord whose palace is the highest of the high,
by His Name millions of sins are wiped away. ॥1॥
In His refuge there is lasting joy for that person
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whom God Himself, in His mercy, joins to His feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ; ਲਖੇ. ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
The Lord whose wonders cannot be understood,
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ; ਸਭ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
and whose support is in every heart,
is revealed in the heart through the company of the Guru;
His devotees worship Him with love at all times. ॥2॥
Even as He gives, His treasures never run short.
In an instant He is able to create and destroy.
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one can turn back His command;
He alone is the eternal King over the heads of kings. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
The One whose shelter we have, in Him too is our hope;
1145: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਰਾ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
to Him alone is our prayer, to be spared sorrow and to gain comfort.
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ; ਸਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
The Lord preserves the honour of His servant everywhere;
The woman who weeps makes weeping her daily rule,
ਬਲਨ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ; ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
for the ties of dealing with the departed keep coming to her mind.
But if someone understands that such ties do not last, and becomes detached,
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ; ਫਿਰਿ ਸੋਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
then neither birth nor death brings him joy or grief again. ॥1॥
All the world's business and its whole expanse are Maya's;
only a rare one has taken the support of the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Maya of three qualities holds sway over all.
Whoever clings to it is beset by troubles and sorrows.
There is no peace without remembering the Name;
only a fortunate one obtains the treasure of the Name. ॥2॥
One who gives his heart to a man in costume
regrets it when the costume is taken off and he sees the truth.
Just as relying on the shade of clouds as lasting shade,
so is this world's expanse the root of attachment and other vices. ॥3॥
If someone obtains the one thing, the treasure of the Name,
only his real task of life is fulfilled.
The one who by the Guru's grace has gained the Name,
O Nanak, his coming into the world is accepted. ॥4॥20॥33॥
By slandering a saint with false charges, a person wanders through many births,
for in slandering a saint he makes himself sick with those very faults;
through slander of a saint he endures sorrows here,
and the messenger of death punishes the slanderer. ॥1॥
Those who keep up quarrels with the Lord's devotee,
ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
those slanderers find no spiritual joy in life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Slandering a devotee, a person pierces his own body through with those faults;
slander of a devotee makes the slanderer suffer hell;
ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਗਲੈ ॥
through slander of a devotee one rots in womb after womb,
ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਲੈ ॥੨॥
and through slander of a devotee one falls from a high spiritual state. ॥2॥
The slanderer never attains a high spiritual state;
he sows the seed himself and eats its fruit himself.
He proves worse than a thief, an adulterer or a gambler,
for the slanderer carries on his head a load of vices that were not in him before. ॥3॥
The Supreme Lord's devotees bear enmity to no one.
Whoever takes their shelter crosses the world-ocean.
The Primal Being Himself has set the slanderer on the wrong path;
O Nanak, the heap of his past deeds of slander cannot be wiped out by his own effort. ॥4॥21॥34॥
The Name is now my Vedas and my sounding of the horn;
the Name fulfils all my tasks;
the Name is my worship of the gods;
the Name is my service to the Guru. ॥1॥
The perfect Guru has firmly planted the Lord's Name in my heart;
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
of all tasks, remembering the Lord's Name is the highest. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Name is my bathing at holy places on festival days;
the Name is my giving of everything in charity.
Those who take the Name all become pure in conduct;
those who repeat the Name are my brothers and friends. ॥2॥
The Name is for me all omens and auspicious times;
the Name is my fill of every tasty delight.
The Name is all my religious rites;
the Name is my pure way of dealing. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ. ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
Blessed is the one in whose mind God alone has come to dwell.
ਸਗਲ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
The Lord is the support of all beings.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
O Nanak, blessed is the one who sings the Lord's praises with mind and body,
whom God keeps in the company of the holy and gives the gift of His Name. ॥4॥22॥35॥
1146: O Lord, the pauper to whom You give the wealth of Your Name,
his many sins go and his mind becomes pure.
All his wishes are met and all his tasks are accomplished.
O Lord, You Yourself give Your Name to Your devotee. ॥1॥
Devotion to the sovereign Sustainer of the world always bears fruit.
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Master can do all and have all done; no one goes empty-handed from His door. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Lord, You destroy the sick man's sickness,
You wipe out the sufferer's grief,
and the one who finds support nowhere You seat in a place of honour.
O Lord, You Yourself join Your servant to Your devotion. ॥2॥
O Lord, to one honoured nowhere You give honour everywhere.
Through Your devotion even a great fool becomes wise and full of understanding.
The fear of all that frightens leaves his mind.
ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੩॥
The Lord dwells always in the mind of His servant. ॥3॥
The transcendent Lord is the treasure of all comforts,
and His life-giving Name gives understanding of the spiritual life and reveals its secret.
The one whom He in His grace joins to the service of the saints,
O Nanak, stays always in the company of the holy. ॥4॥23॥36॥
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, every kind of sin is driven out.
In the company of the holy, one's way of life keeps clear of the filth of vice,
and through that company love for the one God springs up. ॥1॥
The company of the holy is the name of that place
where only the praise of the transcendent Lord is sung. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, the round of birth and death comes to an end,
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
in the company of the holy, the messenger of death can give no fright,
for in the company of the holy the word that purifies life is recited,
and there, in the company of the holy, only the Name is spoken. ॥2॥
The seat of the company of the holy is such that those who stay there stand firm against vice,
and in the company of the holy all sins are destroyed.
In the company of the holy God's praise goes on, which keeps one from the filth of vice.
In the company of the holy, all the pains born of pride are driven away. ॥3॥
The company of the holy never perishes.
In the company of the holy the Lord, treasure of virtues, ever dwells,
and in that company the Master always makes His home.
O Nanak, the Lord is woven into it like warp and weft. ॥4॥24॥37॥
When God Himself protects a person, no sickness can touch him.
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ; ਹੋਇ. ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
No pain and no torment can reach that person.
The one on whom God shows His grace,
from over his head He removes death, the fear of spiritual death. ॥1॥
The Lord's Name alone is a person's constant companion.
ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One in whose mind it comes to dwell always enjoys bliss, and the messenger of death does not come near him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਇਹੁ. ਨ ਸੋ; ਤਬ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
When this being did not exist at all, who but God could have created him?
See from what source God shaped what a lovely form.
He Himself kills and He Himself gives life.
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
Know this for certain: every power is in His hands.
My beloved Lord is the Master of those who have no master.
ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
His very Name is Destroyer of Pain.
ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
Keep singing His praises and you will receive every comfort. ॥3॥
O Master, You hear the prayer of Your saints.
The saints keep their soul, their breath and their wealth in Your keeping.
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
O Lord, this whole world is Your creation, and all people fix their minds on You.
1147: O Nanak, the one whom You in Your grace bless with Your Name enjoys spiritual bliss. ॥4॥25॥38॥
O Lord, in this world full of vice I live on Your support alone.
All beings rest on Your support and sing Your praises.
O Lord, spiritual death has no hold on one who has Your support.
With Your support the noose of attachment to Maya is broken. ॥1॥
In this world and the next, Yours is our only support, O Lord.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ; ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one Master pervades the whole creation. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Lord, with the support of Your Name I enjoy spiritual bliss,
and with that support I keep repeating the mantra of Your Name the Guru gave me.
O Lord, with the support of Your Name one crosses the world-ocean;
You are able to protect all, and You are an ocean of every comfort. ॥2॥
O Lord, no fear can touch one who has the support of Your Name.
The eternal Lord alone knows what is in every heart.
O Lord, all beings have Your support, and in every mind Your Name is the strength.
Here and hereafter, You alone are the support of all. ॥3॥
O Lord, Yours is our only prop and Yours our only trust,
O God, treasure of virtues, all beings fix their minds on You,
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
and Your servants enjoy spiritual bliss repeating Your Name again and again.
O Nanak, you too keep remembering the eternal Lord, the treasure of virtues. ॥4॥26॥39॥
The true Vaishnav first of all gives up seeking out the faults of others.
ਉਤਰਿ ਗਈ; ਸਭ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
All the anxiety of his own mind lifts away,
and he drives out greed and attachment altogether.
Seeing God ever present beside him, a person becomes the highest Vaishnav. ॥1॥
Such a true renouncer is rare in the world;
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
only such a person truly repeats the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He who becomes a true Vaishnav leaves the company of pride,
the hold of lust and anger leaves his mind,
and he always remembers the Lord's Name.
Such people are carried across the world-ocean in the company of the holy. ॥2॥
To him enemy and friend look alike, both friends,
and he sees the Lord pervading all beings.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Taking God's will as sweet, he has ever enjoyed spiritual bliss,
the one in whose heart the perfect Guru has firmly fixed the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
The one whom God in His grace protects Himself
is the true devotee; he alone repeats the chant of His Name.
ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
One who took the Guru's teaching on how to live has light of understanding in his mind.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੪੦॥
Says Nanak: that person's life has come to success. ॥4॥27॥40॥
Spiritual bliss does not come from earning great wealth,
nor does it come from watching the dances of plays.
Happiness does not come even from conquering many lands.
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
But by singing the Lord's praises every comfort is found. ॥1॥
Enjoy the comfort and bliss of stillness of mind in the company of the holy,
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but that company is found only by great good fortune; through the Guru, always repeat the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Mother, father, son and wife lay the nooses of attachment to Maya.
Prescribed religious rites are nooses too, for through them a person grows proud of what he has done.
But when God, who can cut these nooses, comes to dwell in the mind,
ਤਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
then, while living among his family, a person enjoys spiritual bliss, staying joined to God's feet. ॥2॥
All beings are beggars at the door of God, who can give everything.
He is the treasure of all virtues, infinite, and no far shore of His being can be found.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
The one on whom the beloved Lord bestows His grace,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਿਨੈ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
that person alone has always repeated the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
Keep praying at the door of your own Guru,
and keep saying: O Master of creation, O Timeless Being, treasure of virtues, have mercy.
Says Nanak: I have come to Your refuge;
keep me at Your feet, O Lord, as it pleases You. ॥4॥28॥41॥
One who, meeting the Guru, gave up attachment to Maya,
1148: and through the Guru began to repeat the Lord's Name,
his anxiety came to an end and love for the Name took hold of him,
and he who had slept for many births in the sleep of attachment to Maya has now woken. ॥1॥
The one whom the Lord in His grace joins to His service and devotion
ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
enjoys every spiritual bliss, staying in the Guru's company. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who through the Guru's word has rid his mind of sickness and vice,
who keeps the medicine of the Name stored within his mind,
on meeting the Guru, finds bliss arising in his mind.
The Lord's Name is the treasure of all comforts. ॥2॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ. ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
From his mind the dread of birth and death and the fear of death's messenger are wiped out,
and through the company of the holy his heart-lotus, once turned away towards Maya, blossoms.
Singing God's praises, he reaches an inner resting place that stands firm against Maya's attacks,
and all his tasks are accomplished. ॥3॥
His rare human body is accepted, here and hereafter,
ਸਫਲ ਹੋਈ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
and it comes to fruition through repeating the Lord's Name.
Says Nanak: God has shown me His grace,
and I too repeat His Name with every breath and every morsel. ॥4॥29॥42॥
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
God, whose renown is higher than all,
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
sing His praises for ever and ever.
By remembering Him all pain goes away
and every joy comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥
O my mind, keep remembering that eternal Lord alone.
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ. ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By this remembrance you will hold a high spiritual state in this world and the next. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Remember Him who pervades all, who is free of the stain of attachment to Maya, the Creator of all,
who gives food to all beings and creatures,
who can forgive millions of sins in a moment,
and who always carries across the world-ocean those who worship Him with love. ॥2॥
He has found the lasting wealth of the Name and lasting honour, here and hereafter,
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
who has received from the perfect Guru the understanding of remembrance that keeps him steady against vice.
The one whom the Protector Lord in His grace gives the gift of remembrance,
all the darkness of attachment to Maya is driven from within him. ॥3॥
His attention stays fixed on God's feet,
he sees the Lord who is free of desire pervading everywhere,
and having wiped out every wandering and fear, he meets the Sustainer of the world,
O Nanak, the one on whom the true Guru is kind. ॥4॥30॥43॥
God, by remembering whose Name understanding of the spiritual life arises in the mind,
troubles are erased, and one comes to rest in comfort and stillness of mind,
this gift comes only to the one to whom God gives it;
God joins that person to the service of the perfect Guru. ॥1॥
O Lord, Your Name is the root of all comforts.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my mind, sing His praises all eight watches. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Whatever he asks of God, that very fruit he receives,
the person who settles the Lord's Name in his mind.
Fixing his thoughts on the Lord, his round of birth and death comes to an end,
ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
and joining his attention to God with loving devotion, he is saved. ॥2॥
Lust, anger and pride are destroyed within him,
the cords of attachment to Maya snap,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
and he lives on God's support day and night,
the one to whom the transcendent Lord gives the gift of His Name. ॥3॥
O Master, who can do all and have all done,
in Your grace keep me joined to Your service and devotion;
Your servant Nanak has come to Your refuge. ॥4॥31॥44॥
ਲਾਜ ਮਰੈ; ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
One who does not remember the Name is weighed down by shame within himself.
Without the Name, how can a person sleep in peace?
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
One who gives up remembering the Lord yet longs for the highest spiritual state,
1149: longs in vain, for without the root how can a branch grow? ॥1॥
O my mind, keep remembering the Guru, God.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ; ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This remembrance removes the filth of many births, cuts the nooses of Maya and joins one to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
A stone-hearted person gains no purity by bathing at a place of pilgrimage;
the filth of pride clings to his mind, that he has made the pilgrimage.
Millions of prescribed rites only become the cause of the nooses of pride.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਪੂਲੁ ॥੨॥
Without remembering the Lord, these rites are only a useless bundle on one's head. ॥2॥
Without eating, the fire of hunger is not quenched.
Only when the disease within goes do the body's pains go.
That person stays ever caught in lust, anger, greed and attachment,
ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੩॥
who does not remember the God who made him. ॥3॥
ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ; ਧੰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Blessed are those Gurmukhs who repeat the Lord's Name,
who praise God all eight watches and sing of His virtues.
They hold the wealth of devotion to the Lord, the wealth of the Creator's Name,
O Nanak, those who stay in the refuge of the infinite, all-pervading Lord. ॥4॥32॥45॥
The one with whom the true Guru is well pleased has every fear removed,
for he keeps the Name of the Lord free of Maya settled in his mind.
The one on whom God, merciful to the meek, shows His grace,
all the bonds of attachment to Maya are destroyed within him. ॥1॥
Great comfort and bliss of stillness of mind abide within him,
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ. ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and in the company of the holy all fears and doubts go from one whose tongue keeps uttering the life-giving Name of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one who comes to love God's lovely feet,
the great ghost of an evil nature within him is ended in a moment.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Repeat the chant of the Lord's Name all eight watches;
the Guru, God, who can protect all, will Himself protect you too. ॥2॥
and keeps close watch over every breath of His devotees.
Say, what harm can mere men do to the devotees?
ਜਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੩॥
God gives them His hand and saves them even from death's messengers. ॥3॥
His glory is spotless everywhere and his way of life ever pure,
in whose mind and thoughts the transcendent Lord has come to dwell.
The one to whom the Guru in his grace gave the gift of the Name,
O Nanak, has obtained the treasure of the Name. ॥4॥33॥46॥
My Guru, the Lord, is the root of all creation and master of all powers,
the giver of life, breath and every comfort, and He dwells near all.
That King dispels all fears and is Himself imperishable;
when one has sight of Him, all one's pain goes away. ॥1॥
O Lord, wherever I look, I see only Your support.
ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am ever a sacrifice to the feet of my true Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Meeting the divine Guru, the Lord, all desires are fulfilled.
He is the giver of every fruit, and His service makes life pure.
God takes His servants by the hand and makes them His own,
and settles His Name in their hearts. ॥2॥
In the one in whose heart You settle Your Name bliss ever abides, and no grief can touch him.
No pain, no ache and no sickness has any power over him.
All that is seen is Your creation, and You alone are able to create it all,
O Guru, transcendent Lord, unreachable and infinite. ॥3॥
His spotless glory spreads everywhere, the one to whom God's wondrous word,
the praise of the all-pervading Lord, has become sweet in his mind.
That Lord is present in water, on land and in the sky,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੭॥
O Nanak, all that happens in the world happens by God's command. ॥4॥34॥47॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਰਣੇ ॥
His mind and body stay absorbed in love for God's feet,
1150: God keeps fulfilling all his needs,
and his life passes singing the Lord's praises all eight watches,
the one to whom the true Guru gave the mantra of the Name, complete in every virtue. ॥1॥
One whose love has formed for the Lord's Name is greatly fortunate.
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In his company the whole world crosses the world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Only one who keeps remembering the one God has true understanding of the spiritual life.
One who gains the wisdom to tell good deeds from bad becomes the owner of the wealth of the Name.
One who keeps remembering the Master has become of high family, touching the highest Lord.
One who keeps examining his own conduct becomes honoured here and hereafter. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace he attained the highest spiritual rank,
the one who began to sing the praises of the Sustainer day and night.
All his nooses of attachment to Maya broke, all his hopes were fulfilled,
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
and the Lord's feet settled in his heart for ever. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Says Nanak: the one whose full good fortune awakens,
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
that person comes into God's refuge.
He himself becomes pure in conduct, and makes pure all who keep his company.
With his tongue he keeps tasting the Name, finest of all flavours. ॥4॥35॥48॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Repeating the Name, no obstacle of lust and the rest blocks the journey of life.
Hearing the Name, life is so raised that the messenger of death turns away from afar.
Repeating the Name, all pains are destroyed,
and the mind stays fixed at the Lord's feet. ॥1॥
ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਭਗਤਿ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Remember the Lord's Name; this devotion lets no obstacle of vice block life's way.
ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With deep love, keep singing the Lord's praises for ever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖੁ. ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
Remembering the Lord, no evil eye can strike,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਦੈਤ ਦੇਉ. ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
remembering the Lord, no demon and no spirit has any power,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਬਧੈ ॥
remembering the Lord, neither attachment to Maya nor worldly pride can crush the spiritual life,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਰੁਧੈ ॥੨॥
remembering the Lord, a person is not caught in the round of births. ॥2॥
Every moment is fit for remembering the Lord,
but only one among many remembers the Lord's Name.
Whether of high caste or low, whoever it may be,
ਜੋ ਜਾਪੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
whoever repeats the Name rises to a high spiritual state. ॥3॥
The Lord's Name can be repeated in the company of the holy,
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
and only there does the full colour of the Lord's Name take hold of a life.
O Lord, show grace to Nanak,
give me the gift of Your Name, O Lord, that I may remember You with every breath. ॥4॥36॥49॥
God Himself is the Shastra for you, and He Himself the Veda.
He Himself dwells in every body, and He Himself knows the secret of every heart.
ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ॥
He whose creation this whole world is, is nothing but light.
He is the root of the whole world, present everywhere and master of all powers. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ; ਗਹਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
O my mind, keep hold of God's support.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ; ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru, worship His lotus feet; no enemy and no pain comes near the one who does. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself brings forth every forest and all vegetation, and He Himself is the root of the three worlds,
He in whose command the whole world is strung like beads on a thread.
He Himself is the one who joins the soul with matter,
He Himself, apart from all, is free of desire, and He Himself, pervading all, enjoys every pleasure. ॥2॥
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ; ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
Wherever I look, there He Himself is present,
and apart from Him there is no other anywhere.
Only by loving His Name can this world-ocean be crossed.
Nanak too sings His praises in the company of the holy. ॥3॥
ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
Liberation, food for the body and the conduct of life: all of it lies in God's power.
ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ; ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
In His house nothing is lacking.
Each one on whom God in His grace is pleased and kind,
O servant Nanak, those people alone are truly fortunate. ॥4॥37॥50॥
In the minds of God's devotees spiritual joy always abides.
They stay steady within, and all thought of worldly fears is gone.
